Name: Joja-mart as ATB
Author: Ideachan
Description:
[b]Install using SMAPI. [/b]
It is recommended if you already use mods (such as a Ukrainian localization) or plan to play with them. Installing via simple file replacement may cause conflicts and fail to work.
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI following the official instructions.[/*]
[*]Download [b]Content Patcher[/b] and extract it into the
[code]\Mods[/code]folder in the game's root directory.[/*]
[*]Extract the chosen archive into the
[code]\Mods[/code]folder:
[list]
[*]For the Ukrainian version by Pereclaw:
[code][CP] ZJoja as АТБ Ukr.zip[/code][/*]
[*]For the English version:
[code][CP] ZJoja as АТБ Eng.zip[/code][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI (installation instructions will provide details; for example, on MacOS, the game launches directly from Steam along with SMAPI).[/*]
[*]Done![/*]
[/list][b]Or replace the original files:[/b]
This method is simpler if you play without mods and prefer to avoid using SMAPI by simply replacing the game files.
[list=1]
[*]Download the files (English version):
[code]Joja as АТБ.zip[/code][/*]
[*]Extract the archive.[/*]
[*]Copy the files (the files only, not the entire folder) and replace them in the game's root directory:
[code]/Content/Maps[/code][/*]
[*]Done![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Artist: yes_i_do
Compiled by: idea_chan
